hooks.logic:
Count up "currentTurn".
Let suffixNoByParamId be the enemy → get-suffix-no-by-param-id with (the enemy → get-current-param-id).
Let v be suffixNoByParamId.
Let hpRate be the HP fraction of the enemy.
Let currentTurn be the register's 'currentTurn'.
If suffixNoByParamId is "1", then
  If currentTurn is more than the numeric entry "turn_count_for_change_phase_1" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy, then set v to "2".
  If hpRate is at most the numeric entry "hp_rate_to_phase_2" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy, then set v to "2".
  If hpRate is at most the numeric entry "hp_rate_to_phase_3" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy, then set v to "3".
Otherwise, if suffixNoByParamId is "2", then
  If currentTurn is more than the numeric entry "turn_count_for_change_phase_2" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy, then set v to "3".
  If hpRate is at most the numeric entry "hp_rate_to_phase_3" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy, then set v to "3".
Otherwise, if suffixNoByParamId is "3" and currentTurn is more than the numeric entry "turn_count_for_change_phase_3" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy, then set v to "4".
If v is not suffixNoByParamId, then
  Let paramIdBySuffixNo be the stat block of form v on the enemy.
  The enemy changes to stat block paramIdBySuffixNo.
  The enemy cancels its cast.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  Let ability be a weighted random move of the enemy.
  If ability is the id of the move labelled "mad_howling_moon_1" on the enemy, then the enemy uses ability with its cast time and then [{abilityId: ability}, {abilityId: the id of the move labelled "mad_howling_moon_2" on the enemy, abilityOptions: call game:ai.AiUtil.makeAbilityOptionsForSubEffect}].
  Otherwise, the enemy uses ability.
Let conditionFlagInFrame be condition flag "ability_done_for_howling_moon" is up this frame.
Let conditionFlagInFrame2 be condition flag "ability_done_for_mad_howling_moon" is up this frame.
If conditionFlagInFrame or conditionFlagInFrame2, then the enemy uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{deformTag: "deformation_01"}], [{builtin: "SET_SA", sa: the NULL_PHYSICAL status}]]} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
If condition flag "damaged_attack" is up this frame and the enemy has the NULL_PHYSICAL status, then the enemy uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{deformTag: "deformation_02"}], [{builtin: "UNSET_SA", sa: the NULL_PHYSICAL status}]]} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
